{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Annoo-dat Blue]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sise Fromm]] maintained a '''vacation palace''' on the celestial body [[Bolad]].<ref name="Polyhedron170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> At some point by [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="15 BBY">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} establishes that the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] animated series, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of which [[Tig Fromm]] has destroyed [[Sise Fromm]]'s vacation palace on [[Bolad]], is set fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Fromm's son, [[Tig Fromm|Tig]], destroyed the residence.<ref name="Polyhedron170" />
